review.rationale: User-authorized C# deployment Hello proof. Npgsql 10.0.3 uses native PostgreSQL TCP with verified TLS, required channel binding, a two-connection pool and bounded read-only SELECT transactions. Only the pooled URL is injected at trusted main deployment; credentials never enter builds or artifacts. Production-only TCP egress is explicit; proof subclasses retain closed egress. No D1/schema/business-data migration. The Npgsql upstream PostgreSQL licence is retained. Undici 7.30.1 is the minimal build-tool security correction for GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c; Wrangler and Containers pins stay unchanged.
